# Salima African Hair Braiding & Beauty Cuts

> African hair braiding based in Pflugerville, Texas. Knotless, box braids, twists, cornrows and locs from Awa and her braiders in Pflugerville. Walk-ins welcome, braiding hair in the shop, and the size you asked for.

- Phone: (512) 299-5642
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Austin, Hutto, Manor, Wells Branch
- Google rating: 4.2 from 52 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/salima-african-hair-braiding-and-beauty-cuts/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/salima-african-hair-braiding-and-beauty-cuts/book.html

## Services
- Knotless braids: Light, neat knotless braids in the size and length you choose, with even parts from front to back.
- Box braids & microbraids: Classic box braids, clean at the root and made to last, down to fine microbraids.
- Twists: Senegalese, kinky and passion twists, worn down or styled up.
- Cornrows & updos: Straight-back cornrows, feed-ins and braided updos for every day or a special occasion.
- Locs: Loc re-twists and loc styles, neat at the root and kind to your scalp.
- Crochet, weave & wash: Crochet braids, weave extensions, takedowns and a wash before you sit down to braid.

## About
Salima African Hair Braiding & Beauty Cuts sits in suite 106 of the stone-front strip center at 1100 Grand Ave Pkwy in Pflugerville, under the green metal roof. Inside: taupe walls, cherry-wood stations, tall mirrors, a row of shampoo bowls and a shelf of braiding hair, so you can pick the right hair on the spot. The salon is run by its owner, Awa. Clients say she is spot on when you show her a picture, and that her braiders are kind, respectful and careful with edges. Some have been coming back for more than 10 and even 16 years, and plenty drive in from Austin and out of town.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: Suite 106, 1100 Grand Ave Pkwy, Pflugerville, TX 78660. It's in the stone-front strip center with the green roof.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM, closed Sunday. Call (512) 299-5642 to check today.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Starting prices on our Booksy menu: knotless from $200, box braids from $180, Senegalese twists from $200, kinky twists from $150, cornrows from $80. The final price depends on size, length and hair, and we confirm it before we start.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome when a braider is free. Booking on Booksy holds your spot, and big styles go best with an appointment.
- Q: Do you provide braiding hair?
  A: Yes, we sell braiding hair right in the shop. Tell us the color and length when you book, or bring your own.
- Q: Can you wash my hair first?
  A: Yes. We have shampoo bowls on site; a wash is $20 and a braid takedown is $45.
